title: fix(mechanic/permissions): the deny template omits node, so node -e escapes every paved skill
description:
## .what
the mechanic .claude/settings.json permission template denies the raw tools the paved skills replace (bash, cd, find, grep, ln, ls, mkdir, mv, sed, tee, npx jest) but omits node. so node -e one-liners run unchecked.

evidence: a driver ran node -e to poll a background task and parse json. no deny named node; pretooluse.check-permissions.sh blocks an unlisted command once, records it in .claude/permission.nudges.local.json, and passes an identical retry. the nudge file held several node -e entries, each a call that went through on its second attempt. the hook allowlist also prints [p]: node from a settings layer above the project.

## .why
- node -e is the most general escape of all: it reads, writes, and spawns with no repo bound, so it reaches every act the other denies exist to route through a safe skill
- a deny rule is the only layer a retry cannot pass, and a deny outranks an allow at every layer
- a local deny on an actor settings symlink is untracked and may be restamped by the next rhachet init

## .shape of the fix
- add "Bash(node:*)" to the mechanic deny template, beside Bash(sed:*)
- the statusLine entry runs node -e through the harness, never through the Bash tool, so the deny does not touch it
- optional: a PreToolUse refusal that names the paved alternatives (rhx skills, the Read tool, head/tail), so the block teaches
